data.name: Burger Bois
data.detailed_description:
Life got you in a pickle? Are you always hanging on ’til fry-day? Got beef?

Burger Bois is a food truck simulator game about flavor, not labor. Play as Patty, the accidental owner of a failing bespoke burger business, and take your business from gutter-to-butter! 

Get the vibe for each customer, and design unique sandwiches from start to finish, crafting your customers’ most vague requests into culinary masterpieces.

“Can I get that burger uhhhhhhh boneless?”

Customers of questionable taste will tell you the flavors, properties, and restrictions that you have to work with. It’s your job to create a bespoke burger that speaks to their stomach and soul.

Discover unique real-world burger ingredients, and mix & match them to build the burger of your customers’ dreams (or nightmares).

Plus, keep an eye out for collectible #FoodPic burgers! Experiment with ingredient combinations to unlock hidden artworks by beloved indie artists such as @sharkeesart, @nautilics and Lucy Mutimer.

With your trusty grillmaster and de facto best friend Fry, you’ll manage your time across all your usual business activities. (Don’t worry! No real-world timers are involved.)

Serve customers, shop around, clap back at reviews, post food crimes online, and best of all - slack off!

Form relationships with regular customers and follow their stories as you plate up burgers that make or break their days.

Serve up bangin’ burgs to get the good word a-spreadin’. Your reputation on the popular restaurant review website “Welp!” will change as you serve customers — and not always for the better. 

Alongside growing your reputation, you’ll play BURGO to catch the attention of the Local Business Association and earn the right to bigger and better parking spots.

With BURGO, reputation isn’t everything. You’ll get to choose your path to victory, be that by collecting ingredients, forging relationships with special customers, or committing culinary war crimes. 

Your ultimate goal is simple: Take your back-alley burger business from the Truck Stop to the prime parking spot outside the Big Game. 

--------------------------------------------------------

Burger Bois is a love letter to food and hospitality, with nods to many of our favorite media. We wanted to combine the food service of Good Pizza, Great Pizza, with the creative challenge of Sticky Business, and the quirky, comedic characters of 90s cartoons like Spongebob Squarepants and Ed, Edd & Eddy. 

--------------------------------------------------------

Key features:

  • Food prep is out. Flavor design is in. 
    Consider the real-world properties and flavors of ingredients to design uniquely satisfying burgers.

  • A city of events!
    There’s always something going on - take advantage of events at each location to boost your business, or create events of your own by posting on social media.

  • Let’s get experimental.
    Play with your food to collect over 20 elusive #FoodPic illustrations, lovingly crafted by indie artists like @sharkeesart, @nautilics and Lucy Mutimer. 

  • We’re all weird here.
    Get to know a cast of relatably weird friends, enemies, and customers (who are sometimes also enemies).

  • Lightheartedly cutthroat competition.
    Manage your truck and boost your reputation to score the hottest parking spots in town and show your rival who's boss!

  • Flavor made real.
    Share your creations with friends—and even export the recipes so you can taste-test for yourself.

data.short_description: Become Patty, the accidental owner of a failing food business. Craft tasty (or nasty) burgers, discover new ingredients, and work hard(ish) to redeem your reputation on the way to the best parking spot of all time. Play with your food in this cozy food truck simulator!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
